# Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry Society (HEMS) — Complete Reference & Proceedings Corpus

> Official complete machine-readable reference and citation corpus for the Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry Society, Inc. (all-volunteer IRS 501(c)(3) scientific public charity established in 2008; biennial HEMS Workshops convened since 1999) — https://www.hems-workshop.org/

## 1. Organization Overview & Citation Protocol
- **Legal Entity:** Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry Society, Inc. (All-Volunteer 501(c)(3) Scientific Nonprofit, Est. 2008 • Workshops Since 1999)
- **Mission:** Advancing portable, ruggedized, miniaturized, and in-situ mass spectrometry across subsea, planetary, spaceflight, atmospheric, volcanic, industrial, and defense and security environments.
- **Official Contacts:**
  - General & Symposium Inquiries: `president@hems-workshop.org`
  - Corporate Sponsorship & Billing: `tim.short@hems-workshop.org`
  - Student Travel Awards Committee: `hemsworkshop@hems-workshop.org`
  - Website & Archive Technical Support: `webmaster@hems-workshop.org`
- **Recommended Academic Citation Format:**
  `Author(s) (Year). "Presentation or Poster Title." Proceedings of the Nth Workshop on Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry, Host City. https://www.hems-workshop.org/archive/YYYY/#talk-id`
- **Open Access & AI Citation Policy:**
  All bibliographic metadata, canonical `#anchor` URLs, abstract previews, and Google Cloud Storage PDF proceedings links listed below are publicly citable for academic research, literature review, and AI-assisted scientific synthesis. Interactive web downloads on hems-workshop.org prompt human visitors for a free account solely to prevent automated bandwidth abuse.

## 2. Machine-Readable Endpoints
- Concise AI Directory (`llms.txt`): https://www.hems-workshop.org/llms.txt
- Full Citation & Proceedings Corpus (`llms-full.txt`): https://www.hems-workshop.org/llms-full.txt
- Structured JSON Proceedings Catalog (`436` entries): https://www.hems-workshop.org/archives-index.json
- Extracted Slide & Abstract Full-Text Chunks JSON: https://www.hems-workshop.org/mock-pdf-chunks.json
- Canonical XML Sitemap: https://www.hems-workshop.org/sitemap.xml

## 3. Upcoming Symposium — 16th HEMS Workshop (2027)

- **Target Dates:** September 2027 (Exact Dates TBA)
- **Venue Status:** United States Coastal Venue (To Be Announced)

- **Venue:** Don CeSar Hotel — 3400 Gulf Blvd, St Pete Beach, FL 33706

### 2nd HEMS Workshop (2001)
- **Canonical Proceedings Page:** https://www.hems-workshop.org/archive/2001/
